rationale: Harshal is building Xybit, a proprietary trading platform, on the heels of scaling Xade Finance to $20M in trading volume—both projects rooted in making DeFi accessible by solving UX and liquidity fragmentation. Yiping is a blockchain researcher and former security auditor at CertiK with deep expertise in smart contract security and Layer-2 innovations, and both share conviction that trustless, accessible finance is critical infrastructure; Yiping's technical depth in Solidity and smart contract audit could strengthen Xybit's security posture while Harshal's operational scaling experience could inform Yiping's Web3 infrastructure interests.
intro_message: Harshal Madnani, meet Yiping Lu — you're both building in fintech/DeFi with complementary expertise: Harshal on scaling accessible trading platforms, Yiping on blockchain security and infrastructure, and you both believe real-world adoption hinges on solving core technical and UX barriers.
